job.title: Tribe Lead CVP & Brand Positioning @ Telenet group (Mechelen, VLG, BE)
job.description:
**Working within Commercial Residential**

As Tribe Lead CVP & Brand Positioning, you set the direction for the Customer Value Propositions and multi-brand positioning of our residential brands: Telenet, BASE, TADAAM, Telenet Entertainment brands such as Play Sports, and Eltrona in Luxembourg. You bring together market, customer, competitor, pricing, product and technology insights and translate them into clear portfolio choices, distinctive propositions, robust business cases, and short- and long-term roadmaps.

You maximise the value and competitiveness of the entire brand portfolio. You clarify the role of each brand and ensure an effective handover to the commercial tribes, which remain responsible for go-to-market, campaigns, channels, journeys and commercial results.

You report to the Chief Commercial Officer, Residential & SOHO and lead a team of Product owner(s), CVP Managers and experts.

Your main responsibilities as Tribe Lead CVP & Brand Positioning

**Define the tribe strategy and multi-brand positioning**

* You define and communicate the tribe’s mission, strategy, outcomes, priorities and roadmap, aligned with the long-term portfolio and market segmentation strategy.
* You steer the allocation of customer segments and market spaces across the brands, make overlaps and potential cannibalisation transparent, and identify new opportunities.
* You translate strategic choices into a clear CVP narrative and directional portfolio recommendations.

**Build a strong fact base for decision-making**

* You integrate market and competitor analysis, benchmarks, customer needs, willingness to pay, pricing, segmentation, and product and technology trends.
* You ensure a consistent fact base and determine when further analysis is required.
* You steer relevant success metrics, including portfolio competitiveness, market share by brand, brand awareness, brand preference, NPS, lead time and business-case realization.

**Lead CVP design, line-up and business casing**

* You are ultimately accountable for the quality and coherence of Customer Value Propositions across the brands.
* You steer the definition of the offer, features, pricing intent, benefits, reasons to believe and concrete line-up.
* You ensure that business cases substantiate customer value, market impact, financial feasibility, risks and expected value, and are ready for decision-making.

**Drive roadmaps, lifecycle management and value creation**

* You develop and prioritize short- and long-term roadmaps for the full portfolio.
* You oversee the CVP lifecycle, monitor market response and performance, and initiate timely optimisation or repositioning.
* You connect long-term choices with actionable recommendations and an approved roadmap for the tribes involved.

**Embed governance and cross-tribe collaboration**

* You represent the tribe in Value Streams, business reviews and relevant strategic governance forums.
* You create alignment with B2C Strategy & Business Steering, Corporate Strategy, Data Acceleration, Product, Finance and the commercial tribes.
* You safeguard clear decision rights between CVP definition and multi-brand positioning on the one hand, and commercial execution on the other.

**Build a high-performing tribe**

* You lead Product owner(s), CVP Managers and experts and build a diverse, collaborative and results-oriented tribe.
* You take responsibility for workforce planning, talent management, knowledge continuity, engagement and development.
* You manage capacity, priorities and the workforce budget, and develop shared CVP methodologies, standards and best practices.

Our ideal candidate has...

* A Master’s degree or equivalent through experience.
* Extensive relevant experience in strategy, portfolio, proposition, product or commercial management, including experience in a senior leadership role.
* Experience in the Belgian telecom, entertainment or digital sector.
* Proven experience in people leadership and in leading cross-functional teams within a complex matrix organisation.
* Strong expertise in customer and market insights, multi-Brand Positioning, CVP design, business casing, pricing and roadmap management.
* A strong strategic vision and helicopter view, combined with decisiveness and accountability.
* A data- and financially driven mindset, with the ability to turn complex information into clear choices.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing and negotiation skills at senior management level.
* Learning agility, resilience and a strong can-do mentality.
* Professional proficiency in Dutch and English; French is a strong asset.

What we offer

You will join a company that actively invests in you and adapts your work environment to your needs, allowing you to grow while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. What’s more?

* Plenty of opportunities to further develop your expertise and leadership through internal mobility and extensive learning opportunities.
* A strategic leadership role with visible impact on our brands, customers, portfolio and commercial results.
* A competitive remuneration package, complemented by a wide range of fringe benefits.
* The pleasure of working with colleagues who are just as passionate as you are.

Apply now!

Ready to help shape the future of our residential brands and Customer Value Propositions? Join us as Tribe Lead CVP & Brand Positioning and turn insights into clear choices, distinctive propositions and sustainable value creation. Apply now .

job.title: Market Intelligence & Portfolio Strategy Lead @ Umicore (Brussels, Brussels Region, Belgium)
job.description:
**About Umicore**
Powering the cars of today and tomorrow. Reducing harmful emissions. Giving unique properties to high-end applications. Giving new life to used metals. As a global advanced materials and recycling group, we develop, produce, and recycle materials for a better life.
  
  
**About Battery Materials Solutions**
Umicore’s battery materials solutions are delivering the future of electric mobility. We improve safety, enable faster charging and boost the range and durability of batteries. But our innovation does not stop there.
  
  
We offer our customers industry leading battery recycling solutions for critical metals like cobalt, nickel, lithium and copper.
  
  
To deliver a circular and sustainable battery materials value chain, we cannot stand still. Solving complex mobility challenges demands ambitious thinking and continuous innovation. This is where you come in.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**
We are currently looking for a
**Market Intelligence & Portfolio Strategy Lead**
to join our office in Brussels, Belgium. In this role you will build and own a single, coherent view of the CAM value chain and turn it into a focused portfolio and the pricing line that goes with it. You will lead three intelligence managers, continuously screen opportunities on attractiveness and right to win, and challenge resource allocation so we invest where we can credibly win at attractive margins.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* OCC Market Model & Intelligence Service: Own the OEM-Cell-CAM model across xEV and non-xEV and operate the MI service catalog within the agreed boundary with technology intelligence
* Winners & Application Requirements: Determine the winners along each tier (OEM → cell maker → CAM) and match them against requirements per segment, so portfolio bets target winnable platforms
* Upstream & Value Chain: Run the upstream lens — pCAM, Ni / Co / Mn / Li intermediates and refining — linked to our integrated cost position Portfolio Screening Framework. Maintain the two-axis screening framework — opportunity attractiveness and right to win — fed by the rolling competitor benchmark
* Sales Consolidation & Performance Insight: Consolidate and interpret sales actuals & forecasts across applications — "are we winning where we said we would play?"
* Pricing Strategy: Own segment- and platform-level pricing posture, walk-away thresholds and the value-based logic account leads defend
* Quarterly Portfolio Council: Run the Council with CCO, CTO and Operations — prioritisation, stage-gates, kill / accelerate decisions — converted into a resource & capex view
* Team Leadership & Analytics: Lead and coach two intelligence managers; drives digital & AI-assisted analytics so insight scales without headcount

**Who We Are Looking For**

* 10+ years in industrials, advanced materials or specialty chemicals; metals recycling an advantage
* Master's degree in a relevant field
* 5+ years in management or strategy consulting, with a track record leading complex projects and teams
* Strong strategic insight and exceptional analytics; turns weak signals into clear recommendations with strong storytelling
* Commercial, financial and pricing instincts; comfortable saying no
* Hands-on experience in operational excellence, due diligence and strategy implementation
* Grounded, balanced stakeholder influencer; credible challenger at senior level
* Builds strong, high-performing teams that leverage diverse perspectives
* At home in multicultural environments; adapts to change and ambiguity while keeping clarity and focus
* Excellent communicator across audiences; fluent English, Dutch and Korean/Chinese a plus; acts with integrity, authenticity and consistency

**What We Offer**
We aim to lead the way. Not just for our customers, but for our employees too. That is why we strive to create a collaborative environment in which we can all succeed, and a culture through which we can all share ideas, develop our expertise and advance our careers. We engage in building an inclusive work culture that offers equal opportunities for all employees irrespective of their diverse backgrounds. As you would expect from a world-leading organisation, we will also reward your contribution with a competitive salary and benefits. With all this and more, imagine what you could do?

job.title: Corporate Strategy Manager @ Aliaxis (Brussels, Brussels Region, Belgium)
job.description:
We are looking for high-potential professionals to join Aliaxis' Corporate Strategy team and support the execution of our Horizon 2030 ambition.
  
  
If you have gained strategy experience in a top-tier consulting firm and/or an international corporate environment, and are eager to help shape the future of a global Belgian industrial leader, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Who Are We**
At Aliaxis, we design innovative, reliable, and sustainable solutions for fluid and energy management. Our pipe and fitting systems work seamlessly behind the scenes — delivering peace of mind to customers and end users across the globe.
  
  
With operations in over 40 countries, we tackle the most complex challenges in the building, infrastructure, industrial, electrical, and agriculture sectors. But what truly drives us is our people. Our 15,000 employees bring the expertise, passion, and dedication that power everything we do.
  
  
Together, we make life flow — and we're looking for talented individuals to join us on that journey.

We're offering a unique opportunity to join a global Belgian company with an international and collaborative culture. Aliaxis is focused on reinforcing our operational foundations and building the agility needed to capture future growth opportunities. Through our Horizon 2030 strategy we're evolving into a more disciplined, high-performing global Group — and we're looking for talented people who want to contribute to this long-term strategic journey.

In this role, you will contribute to Aliaxis' strategic agenda by supporting the strategic planning process, partnering with the Executive Committee on enterprise-wide priorities, and helping the divisions develop winning market strategies.
  
  
Reporting to the Head of Strategy within a horizontal team structure, your key responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Leading strategic analyses and projects that support the definition, execution, and tracking of Aliaxis' enterprise strategy.
* Driving high-impact initiatives across business units and functions, including growth strategy, market entry, transformation, operating model improvement, and portfolio optimization.
* Identifying strategic opportunities, risks, and growth levers through market, customer, competitor, and industry analyses, and translating insights into recommendations for senior leadership.
* Supporting portfolio strategy, M&A, and partnership activities through market assessments, commercial due diligence, and strategic evaluations.
* Building strong relationships with business and functional leaders globally to drive strategic alignment and value creation.
* Coaching and supporting junior members of the Corporate Strategy team, contributing to a high-performing and collaborative team environment.

**About You**
The Corporate Strategy team is a key talent pipeline within Aliaxis. We are therefore looking for individuals with the potential to grow into broader leadership roles, whether within Strategy or across the organization. To succeed in this role, you will bring:
  
  

* 5 to 8 years of strategy experience in a top-tier consulting firm and/or a corporate environment.
* Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics or a related field.
* Track record of leading complex strategic initiatives such as growth strategy, transformation, operating model optimization, commercial due diligence, market intelligence, or portfolio management.
* Strong analytical and financial skills, including market analysis, business case development, financial statement interpretation, and executive-level reporting.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influential skills with the ability to drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups (including C-suite executives). Outstanding presentation skills.
* Experience working across functions and geographies in international organizations.
* A proactive, results-oriented mindset, combining strategic thinking with a hands-on approach to delivering impact.
* Interest in industrial and manufacturing businesses.
* Willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis and openness to international career opportunities.

**About Our Workplace**
Aliaxis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer who welcomes candidates and employees from all backgrounds.
  
  
We are guided by our behaviours
**— We Care, We Dare, We Deliver!**
These reflect what we expect from each other and what you can expect from us: a culture that looks after its people, encourages you to challenge and improve, and gives you the space to make a real contribution.
  
  
**How We Welcome You**
For us, equity and belonging start already at the application step: whether it's offering flexibility in scheduling interviews, or ensuring a supportive and inclusive environment, we strive to remove barriers and create equal opportunities for all applicants. Should you have specific needs, please do not hesitate to let us know and we will do our best to accommodate.

job.title: Business Analyst l EU Institutions Project l Brussels @ SEIDOR (Brussels, BRU, BE)
job.description:
#HumanizingTechnology

ABOUT SEIDOR

SEIDOR helps organizations transform and stay competitive through technology and innovation, always putting people first. With over 8,000 professionals in 45 countries, we are a diverse and inclusive global team committed to talent, equal opportunities, and sustainable growth. Will you join us in humanizing technology?

We are looking for an experienced **Business Analyst** to join our team **Near-site in Brussels.**

WHAT WILL YOU DO IN YOUR DAY-TO-DAY?

* Analyse business contexts, objectives and stakeholder needs to ensure alignment with strategic goals.
* Gather, validate and document business and functional requirements through stakeholder interviews and workshops.
* Analyse existing business processes, identify inefficiencies and propose improvements.
* Model business processes, workflows and system interactions using BPMN, UML or equivalent methodologies.
* Perform gap analyses between current and target business processes and capabilities.
* Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Prepare Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, business cases and other project documentation.
* Identify business and operational risks and propose appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Define and document functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, security and usability.
* Support test case design, User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and requirements validation.
* Maintain requirements traceability and manage changes throughout the project lifecycle.
* Facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, technical teams and external contractors.
* Prepare clear presentations, diagrams and reports for senior stakeholders.

  

WHAT DO WE EXPECT FROM YOU?

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Communication, Veterinary, Bioengineering, Business Management, Public Administration or equivalent.
* At least 7 years of relevant IT experience.
* Practical experience in business analysis, requirements engineering and business process modelling.
* Knowledge of business analysis methodologies aligned with **BABOK and IEEE 29148**.
* Experience developing user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria, state diagrams and entity relationship models.
* Experience preparing business analysis deliverables and facilitating stakeholder workshops.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to synthesise complex information and present findings clearly to senior stakeholders.

**Specific requirements:**

* Experience with modelling and diagramming tools such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, UML, BPMN or Camunda Modeler.
* Knowledge of wireframing tools such as Axure, Balsamiq, Pencil or equivalent.
* Experience using Jira or equivalent requirements management tools, including backlog management, epics and user stories.
* Experience collaborating through Confluence, SharePoint or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to create and maintain BRDs, functional specifications, process diagrams and requirements traceability matrices.
* Experience defining acceptance criteria and supporting UAT activities.
* Ability to facilitate workshops, consolidate stakeholder feedback and prioritise business requirements.
* Strong skills in producing presentations, charts, diagrams and visual documentation for senior stakeholders.

**Additional valued skills:**

* 3+ years of experience in EU data protection regulations.
* 3+ years of experience with case management systems and document workflow solutions.
* 3+ years of experience using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, RUP, or similar methodologies.
* 3+ years of experience in international/intergovernmental organizations or central public administrations.
* 3+ years of experience in the pharma, healthcare, or agri-food sectors.

job.title: Junior Project Manager | Automotive @ Capgemini Engineering (Diegem, VLG, BE)
job.description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

-------------

As a Junior Project Manager, you will play a key role in coordinating and delivering improvement projects across an international automotive environment, working alongside strategic alliance partners and key stakeholders across the automotive industry.

* **Acting as a central point of contact** between internal departments and external partners, organising and facilitating follow-up meetings that drive actions forward and keep stakeholders aligned.
* **Conducting benchmarking activities** to identify best practices and improvement opportunities, supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement programs across the organisation.
* **Collaborating with alliance partners** to identify opportunities for cost reduction and CO₂ emission improvements, including supporting discussions and negotiations with insurance companies on vehicle premiums and ratings.

----------------

* **At least 2 years of professional experience** in Project Management or Project Coordination, with a proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously in a structured and organised way.
* **Strong communication and stakeholder management skills** , with experience organising meetings, driving actions to completion, and building effective relationships across different business functions and cultures.
* **A proactive, hands-on mindset** — you are a self-starter who is comfortable working independently in an international and multicultural environment, with a willingness to learn and grow.

**Sollicitatieproces**
----------------------

Wat kun je verwachten

### Solliciteren

Solliciteer gemakkelijk en snel via de knop bij deze vacature. Na je sollicitatie bekijken we je cv en motivatie zorgvuldig. Voor leidinggevende rollen nemen we hier iets meer tijd voor, zodat we echt goed kunnen beoordelen of jouw profiel aansluit. We doen ons best om je zo snel mogelijk een reactie te geven. Worden we blij van je cv en motivatie? Dan nodigen we je uit voor een persoonlijke kennismaking.

### Persoonlijk kennismaken

Je maakt kennis met twee toekomstige collega’s: jouw leidinggevende, directe collega’s of de recruiter. Het doel van dit kennismakingsgesprek is om meer te weten te komen over jouw achtergrond, ambities en competenties. Daarbij maken we gebruik van de STARR-methodiek en bespreken we jouw ervaringen aan de hand van praktische voorbeelden uit eerdere werkzaamheden en activiteiten. Natuurlijk vertellen we je ook graag meer over de functie, het team en TenneT als organisatie. Na een paar dagen bellen we je op om onze ervaringen te delen.

### Het tweede gesprek

In dit gesprek gaan we wat dieper in op de match. In dit gesprek maak je kennis met twee andere collega’s. Je leert elkaar beter kennen en gaat meer inhoudelijk de diepte in. Wij zijn graag transparant en eerlijk in wat het werk inhoudt. Zo weet jij ook precies wat je kan verwachten. Is het een match? Dan gaan we over naar het aanbod.

### Assessment voor leidinggevende functies

Voor leidinggevende functies vinden we het belangrijk om meer te ontdekken over jouw capaciteiten, drijfveren en kwaliteiten. Dan nodigen we je uit om een assessment te doen. Je hoort vooraf wat het assessment inhoudt en hoe het werkt. De resultaten mag je natuurlijk altijd zelf inzien.

### Het aanbod

We zullen je snel een goed aanbod doen. Je krijgt een salarisvoorstel en een overzicht van ons arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket.

### De screening

Met een ondertekende arbeidsovereenkomst op zak is er nog één stap te gaan: de pre employment screening. TenneT heeft de maatschappelijke taak om Nederland 24/7 aan te houden. We moeten risico’s op verstoringen zoveel mogelijk uitsluiten. Daarom vragen we van elke medewerker minimaal een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag. Als blijkt dat er geen bezwaren zijn tegen je aanstelling, staat niets jouw start meer in de weg. Voor sommige functies is een VOG niet afdoende en volgt een uitvoerige screening, zoals een AIVD. Jij kan pas van start gaan wanneer de screening(s) succesvol zijn afgerond.

### Onboarding

Nadat alles rond is ga je op de eerste werkdag van de maand starten met jouw onboarding bij TenneT. Twee dagen met al jouw nieuwe collega's om te ontdekken wie TenneT is en hoe wij werken. Je leert alle ins & outs kennen. Daarna ga je verder met onboarden binnen je team. Welkom!

job.title: Executive Strategy @ KPMG Nederland (Amstelveen, North Holland, Netherlands)

Jouw uitdagingen
  
  

* Het identificeren van strategische groeimogelijkheden (nationaal en internationaal)
* Het beoordelen van de aantrekkelijkheid en concurrentiepositie van ondernemingen

* Een relevante masteropleiding (bijvoorbeeld in bedrijfskunde, economie of een andere technische studie)

* For this job, we are seeking candidates with a good command of the Dutch language, both spoken and written, to meet the demands of our current clients.

*Twijfel je of je moet solliciteren omdat je niet aan alle vereisten voldoet? Als deze functie je aanspreekt en je jezelf herkent in het profiel, dan horen we graag van je. Omdat wij geloven dat talent op veel verschillende manieren groeit en tot uiting komt.*
Wat ga je doen?
  
  
Word onderdeel van ons Strategy-team en werk aan de meest impactvolle strategische vraagstukken van onze cliënten. Je helpt organisaties bij het vormgeven van hun toekomst, van fusies en overnames tot bredere groeistrategieën en transformaties. Samen met ervaren teams werk je aan complexe uitdagingen, direct met senior stakeholders, en draag je bij aan beslissingen die de koers van organisaties bepalen. Denk hierbij aan het ondersteunen van integraties en carve-outs, het realiseren van operationele transformaties en het adviseren van investeerders bij (des)investeringen en waardecreatie.
  
  
Vanaf dag één werk je direct samen met cliënten en adviseer je op senior niveau. Je analyseert complexe vraagstukken, ontwikkelt datagedreven inzichten en vertaalt deze naar concrete strategische aanbevelingen. Je draagt bij aan het creëren van waarde door het analyseren van prestaties, het identificeren van groeimogelijkheden en het onderbouwen van strategische keuzes. Daarbij werk je intensief samen met private equity-investeerders en corporates in uiteenlopende sectoren.
  
  
Deze rol biedt een steile leercurve: je ontwikkelt je analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden op projecten, ondersteund door een uitgebreid trainingsprogramma en continue coaching. Je maakt deel uit van een hecht en ondernemend team met een open cultuur en sterke focus op samenwerking en feedback. Wij zoeken analytisch sterke en ondernemende starters die energie halen uit het oplossen van complexe problemen en impact willen maken in een dynamische, veeleisende omgeving.
  
  
Dit bieden wij
  
  

* Brutosalaris tussen € 3.425,- en € 4.215,- afhankelijk van werkervaring, winstuitkering, een vaste onkostenvergoeding en een thuiswerkvergoeding.
* Een flexibel pensioen zonder verplichte eigen bijdrage.
* 30 vakantiedagen (op fulltime basis) en de mogelijkheid om meer dagen te kopen of je vakantiedagen te verkopen.
* Bij KPMG werken we hybride, dus een combinatie van zowel thuis als op kantoor.
* Een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.
* Een leaseauto of een mobiliteitsregeling.
* Laptop en telefoon
* Een uitgebreid aanbod van trainingen en opleidingen die bijdragen aan jouw professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
* Diversiteitsnetwerken op het gebied van pride, gender, ability, cultural diversity en generations die regelmatig verschillende activiteiten organiseren om verschil te vieren!
* Aandacht voor vitaliteit! Sporten op het kantoor in Amstelveen of korting op een sportschool bij jou in de buurt én toegang tot coaching, gezondheids- en vitaliteitprogramma’s.
* ‘Together’ is één van onze kernwaarden. Je kunt dus rekenen op verschillende sociale activiteiten zoals teamuitjes, borrels en evenementen samen met je collega’s.

Sollicitatieprocedure
  
  
Stap 1. Jouw sollicitatie
  
  
Heb je gesolliciteerd? Wat leuk dat je interesse hebt in werken bij KPMG. Na je sollicitatie belt een van onze recruiters jou voor een korte kennismaking en om te kijken of de functie bij jou zou passen. In dit gesprek heb jij ook de mogelijkheid om een aantal vragen te stellen die je misschien nog hebt.
  
  
Stap 2. Het eerste gesprek
  
  
Na de kennismaking nodigen wij jou uit voor het eerste gesprek en tegelijkertijd ook voor de KPMG Talent Pitch. In de Talent Pitch leren wij jou niet alleen kennen, maar leer jij ons ook beter kennen door een rondleiding in de wereld van KPMG. Je vult tijdens de pitch een persoonlijkheidsvragenlijst in en je maakt een capaciteitentest. Het eerste gesprek is met een recruiter en in sommige gevallen is er ook direct al een collega van de betreffende afdeling bij het gesprek aanwezig. Dit gesprek is een wederzijdse kennismaking, waarbij jij dus ook de kans krijgt om alle vragen die je waarschijnlijk hebt te stellen.
  
  
Stap 3. Vervolg gesprek
  
  
Vond je het een positief gesprek en ben jij nog enthousiast? Als wij ook een match zien, volgt er een tweede kennismaking. In dit tweede gesprek gaan we dieper in op de functie en de inhoudelijke thema’s waar je mee te maken krijgt. Het kan zijn dat je gevraagd wordt een businesscase voor het gesprek voor te bereiden. Soms vindt er nog een laatste gesprek plaats.
  
  
Stap 4. Aanbod
  
  
Is er een match? Dan doen wij jou een aanbod en start jij hopelijk snel bij KPMG. In het aanbod vind je niet alleen je salaris, maar lees je alles over ons complete aanbod aan arbeidsvoorwaarden. Denk aan jouw pensioen, vakantiedagen en meer! Ga jij akkoord met ons aanbod? Dan feliciteren wij jou als nieuwe collega en nemen we de laatste stap.
  
  
Stap 5. Screening
  
  
Wij willen in alle opzichten een integere en betrouwbare organisatie zijn, dus screenen we iedereen die bij ons komt werken. DISA doet deze screening en checkt daarbij onder andere referenties. Alles in orde? De weg naar een mooie carrière bij KPMG ligt voor je open. Je start dan met het uitgebreide onboarding-programma.
  
  
Wil je meer weten over onze sollicitatieprocedure? Neem dan contact op met HR Recruitment via recruitment@kpmg.nl

job.title: Programma Manager Cybersecurity - Strategic Accounts @ Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity (Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands)
job.description:
The digitization of our society is proceeding at lightning speed. Software, systems and digital networks are everywhere and increasingly interconnected. Organizations and society lean heavily on these technologies. But while our dependence grows, so does the threat: cybercrime is on the rise and poses a risk to organizations as well as to the functioning of our society. Therefore, it is more important than ever to better protect our digital assets and systems.

At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity, we are committed to performing just that. Our mission is to be our clients' Expert Partner a trusted partner that helps companies and public organizations understand risk, strengthen their resilience and comply with increasingly stringent standards and regulations. With more than 200 cybersecurity professionals, we offer services that encompass people, process and technology: from awareness training and social engineering to penetration testing, security consulting and compliance.

As a Program Manager, you'll lead cybersecurity programs that bring together multiple related projects, all aimed at helping our clients achieve their strategic goals. We deliver services through an approach that strengthens our clients' cyber resilience across people, processes, and technology.

In this role, you’ll coordinate and manage large-scale client programs, each with an annual turnover exceeding €800K, and act as the primary advisor for our clients. You'll collaborate closely with various stakeholders, including CISO’s, IT Managers, Security Officers, and board members. Your main goal is to ensure high-quality project outcomes and maximize client satisfaction.

You will be part of a team spread across Europe. The team is all about collaboration and an entrepreneurial mindset. We value face-to-face connections and meet quarterly in different European cities to strategize, bond, and grow together.

**What will you do as our Program Manager:**

* **Assessment:**
  analyze clients' cybersecurity needs and develop strategies and solutions accordingly;
* **Strategic Alignment:**
  ensure that cybersecurity projects are aligned with overall business goals and strategies. This involves understanding the client’s business and objectives;
* **Strategy:**
  develop security roadmaps for clients with the goal of delivering multidisciplinary services in a business partner role to these clients;
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders across different business units. This includes regular communication and collaboration to ensure cybersecurity efforts support business needs;
* **Program management:**
  coordinate and oversee the projects within the program and possibly manage projects yourself. This includes planning, projects oversight, program governance, resource optimization across projects and reporting;
* **Collaboration:**
  engage with internal and external stakeholders to deliver high-quality services and ensure client satisfaction, aiming to establish a long-term relationship with the client;
* **Subject matter expertise:**
  contribute content-wise to the sales of programs and projects through translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders during sales processes;
* **Team development:**
  coach, guide and motivate consultants working on projects in the program(s) you are responsible for, and keep close contact with team leads in the organization to ensure that consultants work on projects with enjoyment and strength.

**You are a Program Manager with:**

* Relevant experience as a program manager (you may be PMP or PRINCE2 certified);
* Experience in cybersecurity, preferably in a client-oriented role, demonstrating a deep understanding of client needs and challenges;
* Familiarity with cybersecurity directives (NIS2, CRA), information security frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST CSF), and product security standards (IEC 62443), with hands-on implementation experience;
* Strong commercial skills, with the ability to identify opportunities and convert them into successful assignments;
* Experience managing teams, including coaching and mentoring team members to achieve their potential;
* Cross-cultural and international team management expertise for geographically distributed European operations;
* The ability to align cybersecurity initiatives with broader business objectives and strategies.

We also welcome exceptional mid-level professionals who demonstrate strong project management fundamentals, hands-on cybersecurity implementation experience, and a genuine commitment to developing into strategic program leadership roles.

**What can you expect from us?**

At Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity you work in an environment where trust, expertise and social impact are key. We believe that you can really make a difference when you get the space to deepen your knowledge and actively contribute to a safer digital society. What does that look like in practice?

* **Impactful growth:**
  The cybersecurity division of Bureau Veritas is rapidly growing, and you will have the chance to grow along with it. Whether it's about taking on more responsibilities, increasing your visibility within and outside the organization, or pursuing training and education, your career development is a priority. Growth at Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity occurs also by participating in projects that have a real impact on society. Whether protecting smart devices from hacking attempts or performing an IT audit for the government, you'll build your skills while making a difference. You'll receive support through clear growth paths, regular performance reviews and the opportunity for active learning.
* **Working with a diverse client portfolio:**
  Our clients come from many industries and contexts, but have one thing in common: they rely on our expertise to meet security and compliance requirements and build cyber resilience. In your role, you'll help protect people, processes and technology within IT, OT and IoT environments, supporting clients in identifying risks and addressing them with confidence.
* **Work within a highly skilled community:**
  Cybersecurity does not stop at national borders, and so does the way we work. With teams around the world, you'll work with colleagues from different countries, disciplines and cultures, connected by a shared commitment to quality and integrity. We share knowledge, learn from each other and develop new solutions together, supported by initiatives such as our R&D programs and hands-on test labs.
* **A culture of respect, connection and well-being:**
  We actively pursue a safe, inclusive and positive work environment. Our values define how we collaborate, give feedback and assess performance. We support well-being and team bonding through team activities, access to OpenUp and by encouraging a healthy work-life balance with flexible work options. We like to celebrate successes and creating a good work environment. We regularly organize fun activities, ranging from annual ski trips to various wine and beer tastings, sailing trips, barbecues, and more. Team building is important for us.

**Are you the Program Manager we are looking for?**

Do you have questions or do you want to apply? Please send an email to jobs.cybersecurity@bureauveritas.com

* Project Manager
* Implementatie Manager
* Delivery / Release Manager

* Test Manager

Amsterdam

**Make the cross-functional machine work**

* Improve how our internal strategy and planning processes actually run, not how the deck says they run
* Create alignment between teams who each have a defensible reason to prioritise something different

This role reports directly to the Chief of Staff.

* Fluent in both English and German (native), written and spoken

We’re a fast-growing B2C startup, and here, your work has real impact.

job.title: CEO Office - Technical Project Manager (Mensch) @ NEURA Robotics (Riederich, Baden-Württemberg, Germany)
job.description:
**Deine Mission & Herausforderungen**
NEURA Robotics entwickelt die weltweit erste kognitive Robotik-Plattform – Roboter, die sehen, schlussfolgern und gemeinsam mit Menschen in Fabriken, Krankenhäusern und im eigenen Zuhause handeln können. Die nächsten drei Jahre werden darüber entscheiden, wer diese Kategorie weltweit anführt. Wir wollen dieses Unternehmen sein und die europäische Führungsrolle in diesem Markt einnehmen.
  
  
Das CEO Office überträgt die Vision des CEOs in die Realität und beseitigt alles, was zwischen dem Unternehmen und seinem eingeschlagenen Kurs steht. Wir arbeiten eng mit dem CEO und dem Führungsteam an den Themen, die im jeweiligen Quartal am wichtigsten sind – mit der Geschwindigkeit und Qualität, die die jeweilige Situation erfordert.
  
  
In dieser Rolle übernimmst du Initiativen, die sich direkt aus der Vision des CEOs und der Unternehmensstrategie ableiten – Themen, die bestimmen, wohin sich NEURA als Nächstes entwickelt – mit einem klaren technischen Fokus auf unsere Produkte, Plattformen und die dahinterstehende Engineering-Organisation.
  
  
Das reicht von Produkt- und Technologie-Roadmaps, der Entwicklung von Business Cases für neue Produkte oder Spin-offs und der Gestaltung einer skalierbaren Organisation bis hin zu strategischen Partnerschaften, Markteintritten und dem Aufbau von Governance-Strukturen.
  
  
Gleichzeitig kümmerst du dich um kritische, zeit-sensitive Engpässe, die zwischen verschiedenen Funktionen entstehen und ein direktes Eingreifen des CEO Office erfordern – also um die Dinge, die in einem Unternehmen, das so schnell wächst, oft unbemerkt ins Stocken geraten.
  
  
In beiden Fällen übernimmst du die Verantwortung für das gesamte Thema: Du strukturierst das Problem, entwickelst den Weg nach vorn und bringst das Ergebnis erfolgreich ins Ziel – ohne vorgefertigten Fahrplan.
  
  
**Konkret Bedeutet Das Für Dich**

* Du leitest strategische Initiativen, die das Unternehmen skalierbar machen – von der Definition bis zur Umsetzung. Dazu gehören langfristige Wachstumsstrategien, Produkt- und Technologie-Roadmaps, der Aufbau neuer Geschäftsbereiche und die Gestaltung der Organisation.
* Du steuerst Produkt- und Technologiethemen mit einem klaren Mandat des CEOs. Du unterstützt unsere Business Units dabei, übergeordnete Produktvisionen in Roadmaps mit klaren Meilensteinen zu übersetzen. Gleichzeitig schaffst du Transparenz über Releases, Abhängigkeiten und Fortschritte, damit das Führungsteam fundierte Entscheidungen treffen kann.
* Du entwickelst die Business Cases hinter den nächsten strategischen Schritten des Unternehmens – etwa für neue Produkte, Spin-offs, Expansionen in neue Länder, Partnerschaften oder M&A – und koordinierst die operativen, technischen, rechtlichen und organisatorischen Schritte, um diese Vorhaben zum Leben zu erwecken.
* Du gewinnst einen direkten operativen Einblick in die Produktteams und steuerst sie strategisch. Du weißt aus erster Hand, wo die Teams stehen. Im engen Austausch mit dem CEO und dem Führungsteam bereitest du strategische Entscheidungen vor und diskutierst sie, schaffst Transparenz über Status, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten und stellst sicher, dass Entscheidungen tatsächlich in den Teams umgesetzt werden.
* Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Strategie und Umsetzung – über Engineering, Product, Manufacturing, Marketing, Finance und People hinweg. Wenn ein Thema zwischen verschiedenen Funktionen liegt, übernimmst du es und bringst es voran. Dabei sprichst du die Sprache der Ingenieur genauso souverän wie die des Managements.
* Du repräsentierst das CEO Office nach außen gegenüber Senior Partnern, Lieferanten, Investoren und Ansprechpartnern, wenn die Zeit des CEOs nicht ausreicht. Du triffst Entscheidungen, bleibst dran und sorgst dafür, dass Themen konsequent abgeschlossen werden.

**Was du mitbringen solltest**
Diese Rolle richtet sich an jemanden, der bereits Dinge aufgebaut und umgesetzt hat. Das CEO Office ist ein kleines Executive-Team, das im Auftrag des CEOs handelt – deshalb wählen wir unsere Teammitglieder sehr sorgfältig aus.
  
  
Wir suchen jemanden mit einem technischen Fundament und einer Erfolgsbilanz, bei der die Arbeit für sich selbst spricht. Entscheidend ist weniger dein bisheriger Jobtitel als das, was du bereits umgesetzt hast – und welchen Impact und welche Umsetzungskraft du künftig einbringen wirst.
  
  

* Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im technischen Programm- oder Projektmanagement, in der Strategieberatung, im Corporate Development oder im Scale-up-Umfeld – idealerweise in den Bereichen Robotik, Maschinenbau oder Software/AI.
* Technisches Verständnis. Du hast beispielsweise einen Abschluss in Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Engineering Management, Maschinenbau, Software Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich – oder nachweislich tiefgehende Kenntnisse in Bereichen wie Software und AI, Systems Engineering, Mechatronik oder Fertigungsprozessen. Du verstehst Ingenieur, kannst ihre Ansätze kritisch hinterfragen und zwischen technischer Realität und unternehmerischen Entscheidungen übersetzen.
* Nachweisbare Umsetzungskraft – von Anfang bis Ende. Du hast funktionsübergreifende strategische Initiativen von der Problemdefinition über die Umsetzung bis zum Ergebnis geführt – mit der Haltung eines Owners und nicht nach einer reinen Aufgaben-Checkliste. Menschen, die mit dir gearbeitet haben, würden dich als jemanden beschreiben, der Dinge umsetzt – nicht nur als jemanden, der sie koordiniert.
* Erfahrung im Scale-up-Umfeld. Du warst bereits Teil eines Unternehmens, das schnell gewachsen ist, und weißt, an welchen Punkten es in den verschiedenen Wachstumsphasen typischerweise schwierig wird – bei Organisation, Prozessen, Talenten und Governance.
* Starke analytische Fähigkeiten. Du verfügst über Erfahrung mit Financial Modelling, Business Cases, Marktanalysen und P&L-Denken. Du übersetzt Zahlen in Empfehlungen und Empfehlungen in konkrete Entscheidungen.
* Souveräne Kommunikation auf Executive-Level und im Stakeholder-Management. Du erstellst präzise schriftliche Unterlagen, entscheidungsreife Analysen und Entscheidungsvorlagen. Gleichzeitig bewegst du dich souverän auf C-Level mit Executives, Investoren, Lieferanten und Senior Partnern über verschiedene Kulturen und Regionen hinweg – von Europa über die USA bis nach Asien.
* Professionalität und gutes Urteilsvermögen. Du gehst verantwortungsvoll und diskret mit sensiblen Informationen um. Du bringst Ergebnisse – nicht unnötiges Aufsehen.
* Sprachen. Business-fließendes Deutsch und Englisch – beide Sprachen sind für diese Position erforderlich.

job.description:
**Your mission & challenges**
NEURA Robotics is building the world's first cognitive robotics platform — robots that can see, reason, and act alongside people in factories, hospitals, and homes. The next three years will decide who leads this category globally. We intend to be that company, and to be the European leader in this race.
  
  
The CEO Office transfers the CEO's vision into reality and unblocks whatever stands between the company and its trajectory. We work alongside the CEO and the leadership team on the topics that matter most in any given quarter, at the speed and quality the moment requires.
  
  
In this role, you take on the initiatives that derive directly from the CEO's vision and corporate strategy — the topics that define where NEURA goes next — with a clear technical anchor: our products, platforms, and the engineering organization behind them. This ranges from product and technology roadmaps, business case development for new products or spin-offs, and organizational design for scale, to strategic partnerships, market entries, and governance build-out. At the same time, you step in on the critical, time-sensitive bottlenecks that sit between functions and require direct CEO Office intervention — the things that break silently inside a company growing this fast. In both cases, you take work end-to-end: framing the problem, structuring the path forward, and landing the outcome without a playbook.
  
  
**Concretely, This Means You Will**

* Lead strategic initiatives that scale the company — from definition through execution. Long-term growth strategy, product and technology roadmaps, new business setups, organizational design.
* Steer product and technology topics with a CEO mandate — support our Business Units in breaking high-level product visions down into roadmaps with clear milestones, and create transparency on releases, dependencies, and progress for leadership decisions.
* Build the business cases behind the company's next moves — new products, spin-offs, country expansions, partnerships, M&A — and coordinate the operational, technical, legal, and organizational steps to bring them to life.
* Gain operational insight inside the product teams and guide them strategically — you know first-hand where the teams stand, and in close exchange with the CEO and the leadership team you prepare and discuss strategic decisions, create transparency on status, risks, and dependencies, and make sure decisions actually land in the teams.
* Be the interface between strategy and execution — across Engineering, Product, Manufacturing, Marketing, Finance, and People. Where a topic sits between functions, you take it and move it — and you speak the language of engineers as fluently as that of the boardroom.
* Represent the CEO Office externally with senior partners, suppliers, investors, and counterparts when the CEO's time doesn't scale. Decide, follow up, close the loop.

**What We Can Look Forward To**
This role is for someone who has already built things. The CEO Office is a small executive team acting on behalf of the CEO, and we hire carefully. We are looking for someone with a technical foundation and the kind of track record where the work argues for itself — less defined by a job title than by the work you have already done, and by the impact and execution you will bring going forward.

A degree in, for example, industrial engineering, engineering management, mechanical engineering, software engineering, or a comparable technical field — or proven depth in areas such as software and AI, systems engineering, mechatronics, or manufacturing processes. You understand engineers, can challenge them, and translate between technical reality and business decisions.
* Proven delivery, end-to-end. You have led cross-functional strategic initiatives from framing through execution to outcome — with an owner's instinct, not an employee's checklist. People you have worked with would describe you as someone who delivers, not someone who coordinates.
* Scale-up operating experience. You have been inside a company growing fast and know where it breaks at each stage: organization, processes, talent, and governance.
* Strong analytical foundation — financial modelling, business cases, market sizing, P&L thinking. You translate numbers into recommendations, and recommendations into decisions.
* Executive communication and stakeholder fluency. Sharp written materials, board-ready analyses, decision-support memos — and you hold your own with C-level executives, investors, suppliers, and senior partners across cultures and geographies, from Europe to the US and Asia.
* Professionalism and judgment. Sound discretion when handling sensitive information. You bring the work, not the noise.
* Languages. Business-fluent German and English — both are required for this role.
